premium.basis: Premium not explicitly stated in dossier; last pre-announcement close was $6.16 on 2025-06-13.

value_inflection_events.event: Positive initial data from Heart-2 Phase 1b trial of VERVE-102 announced
Rumors of Eli Lilly acquisition reported by Financial Times

leaked_early.details: Financial Times reported on 2025-06-16 that Eli Lilly was nearing a deal, one day before the official announcement.

notes: Deal includes a $3.00 CVR tied to Phase 3 dosing of VERVE-102; Verve faced ~$1.5-2B capital needs to reach commercialization, driving the sale.
